scene: Pocketing the humming token, you exit onto the rainy transit boardwalk.
picture: A flat side view along a wet wooden transit pier at night. Left, a yellow street tram sits with open doors. Left-centre, the player stands holding her red umbrella and glowing turquoise token. Centre, a docked harbour ferry bobbing gently. Far right, a suspended glass cable car hangs ready at a boarding platform.
